title: Odds and luck: overview
summary: 76 probability tables read from the game, with the real luck formula.

blocks.text: The odds hub holds 76 tables : rift spawns, dungeon themes, chests, item rarities, spoils, gemstones, the forge, the market, events... Tick the luck boosts you own and every table updates.
blocks.html: The odds hub holds 76 tables: rift spawns, dungeon themes, chests, item rarities, spoils, gemstones, the forge, the market, events... Tick the luck boosts you own and every table updates.

blocks.text: Distribution : one outcome per roll; the chances add up to 100%. Independent : every line is rolled on its own (a drop table); the chances do not add up to 100%.
blocks.html:
• Distribution: one outcome per roll; the chances add up to 100%.
  • Independent: every line is rolled on its own (a drop table); the chances do not add up to 100%.

blocks.text: Read How luck works before you spend on boosts.
